Content Translation

BoobaStudio's Content Translation feature translates your game content—item descriptions, journal entries, actor biographies—between languages using AI. Perfect for playing modules in a different language or sharing content internationally.

Overview

Content Translation uses AI language models to translate in-game text while preserving RPG-specific terminology, formatting, and game mechanics references. It works with any content that has text fields in Foundry VTT.

How It Works

  • Select Content — choose items, actors, journals, or entire compendium packs
  • Choose Languages — select the source and target languages
  • Translate — the AI translates all text fields while keeping game terms intact
  • Review — check the translations and make adjustments if needed
  • Apply — save the translated content

Accessing Translation

From the BoobaStudio menu

  • Open the BoobaStudio radial menu
  • Navigate to the translation/localization tools
  • Select the content you want to translate

From the Context Menu

  • Right-click on any document (actor, item, journal) in the sidebar
  • Select the BoobaStudio AI translation option

From the Welcome Screen

  • Open the BoobaStudio welcome screen
  • Click the Translation card in the features grid

Supported Languages

Translation supports all major languages including:

  • English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese
  • Italian, Polish, Czech, Japanese, Korean
  • And many more — any language supported by the AI model

Translation Features

Smart Context

The translator understands RPG context:

  • Spell names and ability names are handled appropriately
  • Game mechanics (dice rolls, modifiers) are preserved unchanged
  • Proper nouns and setting-specific terms are kept or adapted contextually

Batch Translation

Translate multiple documents at once:

  • Select an entire folder of items or actors
  • Translate a full compendium pack
  • Queue translations for processing in the background

Format Preservation

  • HTML formatting (bold, italic, lists) is preserved
  • Links and references to other documents remain intact
  • Tables and structured data keep their layout

Tips

  • Review proper nouns — the AI may attempt to translate character or place names
  • Translate by category — do items, then actors, then journals for consistency
  • Use batch mode for large modules to save time and mana
  • Keep originals — make a copy before translating in case you want to revert

Requirements

  • BoobaStudio module installed and configured
  • A configured provider (Module Settings → BoobaStudio)
  • Credit with your configured provider
